bio.text: Mark Perry is serving his seventh term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 66, which includes portions of Pulaski County.
He is a principal with P&P Benefits Group and graduated from the University of Central Arkansas with a B.B.A. in Marketing.
He is a past president of the Jacksonville Chamber of Commerce, the Jacksonville Rotary Club and the Jacksonville Boys & Girls Club.
